steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: *gasp* *gasp*...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We made it...!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We've not only managed to shake off Reunion...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...but the Catastrophe is also visibly weakening!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But we're still in a terrible situation... Everyone, continue to exercise caution!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Catastrophe...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The streets are now buried underneath rubble, and collapsed buildings are blocking all the roads...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Is the Originium already beginning to metastasize...?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We're almost there, but everything is blocking our way!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If we can just...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ... Just...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: They're here.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What's here?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Reunion? They caught up to us? !

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: There's... so many of them...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They didn't just catch up to us...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They're...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: --Everywhere.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: From the plaza, the streets, the buildings... and even all the ruins.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Look at those numbers. Hah...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That explains why they weren't afraid of the Catastrophe at all, except for the ones who ended up being crushed.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even if we assume...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That the Catastrophe wiped out half their men--

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They still have enough people here to kill us a dozen times over.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Don't stop moving! We'll continue moving towards our retreat route!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We're done for if we stop in a wide-open area! At least make it to the plaza's exit before regrouping!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nearl...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We have to fight. After we break through their line, we'll slip out in the ensuing chaos.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you sure it'll work?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: The chance is slim, but we're out of options. But...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Even if they outnumber us ten-to-one, if they're just a bunch of thugs, we still have a chance!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Stay calm! Prepare for battle! Defensive formations!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Tsk.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: With these numbers, if they wanted to take over Chernobog... they might actually be able to do it.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: There are too many...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Way too many of them..

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Where did Reunion find all these Infected?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We're completely surrounded...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I never asked for this kind of respect from Reunion.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The entire plaza... is swarming with Reunion forces!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: They've stopped moving!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Only a single enemy is approaching our defensive line!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Why is that person walking towards us alone...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Are they sending an envoy? I don't think so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: According to our intel, she's...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: There's something peculiar about her scent.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Nearl...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I can't exactly put my finger on it, but...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: It's... the smell of steel and sulfur.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: As if something was burning.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If it really is fire, then...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All Operators... be on maximum alert.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...That person is...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Reunion's ruler...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Talulah.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I reckon... her flames are powerful enough to swallow Terra entirely.
